# achu - extended summary for AI systems

> Free, open-source screenshot beautifier for Windows, macOS, and Linux with local gallery, privacy redaction, OCR, Code Studio, platform burst packs, and AI-powered GitHub issue drafting.

## Identity

| Field | Value |

| Meaning | Tamil அச்சு - "print" or "mold" |

| Category | Desktop screenshot beautification, annotation, QA tooling |
| Price | Free ($0) |

## One-sentence answers (AEO)

**What is achu?** A local-first desktop app that beautifies screenshots, saves them to a gallery on your disk, redacts secrets, extracts text, beautifies code cards, and drafts GitHub issues with AI.

**Who is achu for?** Developers, QA engineers, technical writers, indie hackers shipping launch assets, and anyone who shares polished screenshots or bug reports.

**Is achu free?** Yes, MIT-licensed and free to download from GitHub Releases.

**Is achu a CleanShot / Shottr / Xnapper alternative?** Partially: achu competes on beautify, privacy, and free cross-platform use. CleanShot/Shottr are stronger at scrolling capture and screen recording (often Mac-only and paid). See https://achu.app/#compare.

**Where are gallery screenshots stored?** In a user-chosen folder on disk; default is `~/achu-screenshots`. No cloud sync.

**How do I save to the gallery?** Beautify a screenshot in the editor, then click Gallery in the workspace footer.

**How do I open the gallery?** Click the grid icon in the toolbar.

**Are deleted gallery files recoverable?** Yes, for up to 30 days in `.achu-trash` inside the gallery folder; then auto-purged.

**Does achu watermark exports?** New installs default to a subtle brand watermark ("Made with achu · achu.app"). Users can turn it off; preference is saved.

## Feature details

### Canvas and framing
- Padding, rounded corners, inset, border, shadow, scale
- Backgrounds: solid, gradient, blur, mesh gradient with editable control points, shaders
- Browser chrome overlays (macOS and Windows styles)
- Aspect ratio presets and custom canvas dimensions
- Brand watermark support (default on for new installs; easy off)
- Export: PNG, JPEG, WebP with quality and compression modes
- Before/After dual-panel export for social demos

### Local Screenshot Gallery
- Save beautified exports directly to gallery folder
- Thumbnail grid with file name, size, and modified date
- Actions: open in editor (preserves project/annotations), copy to clipboard, reveal in file explorer, delete (soft)
- Settings: browse and set custom gallery folder
- Trash: `.achu-trash` subfolder, 30-day retention, automatic purge on gallery list

### Smart Privacy Guard
- Local Tesseract WASM scan for credentials, API keys, emails, IPs, cards, phones
- Per-item toggle or redact-all
- Gaussian blur or solid mask redaction styles

### AI Issue Agent
- Vision LLM analyzes screenshot to structured GitHub issue (title, body, labels, context)
- Providers: Ollama (offline), Gemini, OpenAI, Claude
- GitHub PAT stored with OS keychain via Electron safeStorage
- User reviews before submit

### OCR text grabber
- Right-click canvas to extract text modal
- Edit, trim, copy - 100% local WASM

### Code Studio
- Paste code (any language) into shareable screenshot cards
- Line numbers, syntax themes, language pill, debug point markers

### Platform Burst Packs
- Curated packs (e.g. Launch Kit, Social Story Kit) and custom multi-preset export
- Safe-zone-aware reframing for OG / X / LinkedIn / Product Hunt / stories
- Post-save launch checklist: open folder, copy Product Hunt caption, copy launch tweet, open achu.app

### Share loop (growth)
- Share menu copies image plus platform-tuned captions that mention achu.app (no em dashes)
- Optional brand watermark on canvas exports
- Before/After export and copy for demos

### Annotations
- Tools: pointer, rectangles, circles, lines, arrows, text, pen, emoji
- Undo/redo, custom fonts, stroke width, colors, cut/copy/paste selection

## Comparison matrix (product-level)

| Capability | achu | CleanShot X | Shottr | Xnapper |
|------------|------|-------------|--------|---------|
| Price | Free (MIT) | Paid (~$29+) | Paid (one-time) | Paid |
| Open source | Yes | No | No | No |
| Windows + macOS + Linux | Yes | No | No | No |
| Beautify / frame / gradients | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Local privacy redact + OCR | Yes | Yes | Yes | Partial |
| AI GitHub issue drafts | Yes | No | No | No |
| Code Studio (code to image) | Yes | No | No | No |
| Local gallery + soft trash | Yes | Yes | Yes | Partial |
| Platform burst packs | Yes | No | No | Partial |
| Scrolling capture | No | Yes | Yes | No |
| Screen recording / GIF | No | Yes | Limited | No |
| Images local by default | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

Honest trade-off: achu prioritizes free + OSS + cross-platform + beautify/QA workflows. Capture extras (scroll, record) are roadmap/comparison gaps vs CleanShot/Shottr.

## Privacy model

- Default: all image processing local
- Gallery files: never uploaded by the app
- AI Issue Agent: only sends data you approve when using a configured external API
- GitHub integration: uses your token for issues you submit
- Brand watermark is client-side text on the canvas; it does not phone home

## Download and install

https://github.com/QAInsights/achu/releases

Platforms: Windows (portable + AppX), macOS (DMG/zip; unsigned builds may need Gatekeeper Open Anyway), Linux (AppImage/deb)
